title: Ron Herron
body: Ron Herron (born in 1930 in London, England. Died 1994) was a notable English architect and teacher. He was perhaps best known for his work with the seminal English experimental architecture collective Archigram, which was formed in London in the early 1960s. Herron is the creator of one of the group's best known and celebrated projects, The Walking city.
